digest.component_or_area: binding-store persistence and selective tickets-branch publication
propositions: Repository delegation must preserve the boundary between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication without broadening staging or publishing repository checkpoints independently.
Selective commit staging must honor the five-file allowlist, reject unchanged passes without commits, and preserve GET rotation and retired-first publication semantics.

ADR 0099 must document repository versus publication ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, the persistence-vs-publication split, and explicit decisions to reject journal/format-migration/deep-copy approaches.
Repository save() and save_retired() operations must leave git HEAD and index untouched while local files persist, with no independent checkpoint publication.
